description: Declare a Kafka topic as an external asset in the Dagster asset graph — makes it visible for lineage without materializing it from Dagster.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Dagster asset key for a single topic. Mutually exclusive with `topics:` -- use this (with `topic:`) to declare exactly one topic, or `topics:` to declare several from one component instance sharing bootstrap_servers and one observation sensor.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: Kafka topic name for a single topic. Mutually exclusive with `topics:`.

topics.label: Topics
topics.description: Declare several Kafka topics as external assets from one component instance, instead of one ExternalKafkaAsset YAML block (and, with create_observation_sensor=true, one polling sensor and one Kafka connection) per topic. Each entry: `key` (Dagster asset key, required), `topic` (Kafka topic name, required), plus optional `deps` (list of upstream asset key strings), `owners` (list of strings), `metadata` (dict), `group_name`, `description`. All entries share this component's bootstrap_servers, partitioning config, and (if enabled) ONE sensor that polls every topic's offsets over a single Kafka connection per tick -- set `sensor_name` explicitly when using `topics:` with create_observation_sensor=true (there's no single topic name to derive a default from). Mutually exclusive with the top-level `asset_key`/`topic` fields.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps this external asset's health/data-version current (same logic as the standalone KafkaObservationSensorComponent). When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{topic}__observation_sensor' in single-topic mode (asset_key/topic). Required when using `topics:` (no single topic name to derive a default from). Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between health checks. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key exposing `.observe(topic) -> dict`. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True; unset uses kafka-python directly.

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static / multi partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: External Kafka Asset
